reason: A Feishu/Lark integration plugin that bridges bot conversations to DeepSeek Harness sessions and streams agent responses back through interactive cards, with optional outbound text and file delivery.

summaries.zh: 通过飞书机器人接收消息并转发至 DeepSeek Harness 会话，再以流式交互卡片返回回复的桥接插件。
summaries.en: A Feishu bot bridge that forwards messages to DeepSeek Harness sessions and returns responses through streaming interactive cards.

capabilities: receives Feishu bot messages through a long connection
forwards messages to DeepSeek Harness agent sessions
maintains chat-to-session mappings for multi-turn context
updates Feishu interactive cards with streamed responses
sends text, images, and files to Feishu chats
invokes the lark-cli subprocess and Feishu APIs
